claim: proposal-receipt section 3, Phase 1A row 1.4 (branch fix/vendor-stamp-collision-is-a-duplicate-verdict, founder /goal 2026-11-07 delegates the forks), as amended by QA round 3 on PR #775. VendorResolutionService.applyToDocument (apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/vendor-identity/vendor-resolution.service.ts) returns a DocumentStamp: when stamping provider_id collides with the partial unique index uq_pd_restaurant_provider_type_number (restaurant_id, provider_id, doc_type, doc_number WHERE doc_number IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'superseded'; baseline_from_production.sql:11866) it answers kind 'duplicate' naming the earlier live paper (findSameNumberPaper: same house, provider, type, number, status <> superseded, id <> this one) and writes intake_verdict 'duplicate' with a reason naming it on THIS document, leaving provider_id NULL; a failed read is kind 'failed' with a sentence, a failed verdict write is 'duplicate' with recordError; any other error is 'failed' with error.message. Rule 3 (session's call): duplicate replaces only NULL, 'ok' or 'duplicate' (DUPLICATE_MAY_REPLACE); a blank_page, low_resolution, unreadable or bundle verdict stays and the duplicate sentence is appended to its reason. Item 1: document-intake.service.ts resolveVendorFor returns the stamp and ingest answers duplicate true + duplicateOf (and vendorStampError for a stamp that did not land); documents.controller.ts upload carries both. Item 2: persist answers an INSERT number collision (caller named providerId) with the earlier paper's id and duplicateOf, checked before the sha256 dedupe; a failed or empty look-up throws a sentence so ingest returns error (422), never a null id under 200. Behavioural proof: vendor-resolution.service.spec.ts 'the stamp collides with an earlier paper's number' and document-intake-same-number.spec.ts.
